meta.title: The Phone on the Bus
meta.blurb: Lia finds a phone on the bus. Then a strange message appears on the screen... You decide what she does next!

p1.title: The Phone
text: It was Monday afternoon. Lia was on the bus from school to Viçosa. She was tired, and the bus was hot.
Suddenly, she saw something under the seat in front of her: a phone! It had a small [[key|chave]] on the phone case.
First, Lia looked around. Nobody was there. Then the phone [[vibrated|vibrou]], and a message appeared on the screen:

text.msg: Don't forget the key! Saturday, 6 p.m., at the old cinema. Nobody can know about the box. — B

text: Lia looked at the key. Then she looked at the message again. What was the box? And who was B?

p1.eventPt: Lia achou um celular no ônibus

p2a.title: Secret Messages
text: That night, Lia stayed in her room with the phone. She didn't open it, but new messages appeared on the screen.

text.msg: Did you find the key?? — B
Grandpa CAN'T know. It's a [[secret|segredo]]! — B

text: Lia was worried. First, she called her best friend, Davi.
“A secret? A box? A key?” said Davi. “Maybe it's a [[crime|crime]]! Or maybe it's nothing.”
“The meeting is on Saturday,” said Lia. “What can I do?”

p2b.title: The Driver
text: Lia walked to the front of the bus. The driver, Seu Antônio, looked at the phone.
“I know this phone,” he said. “A boy with a [[guitar|violão]] sits there every Monday. His name is Rafa. He studied at IFAL, like you.”
“Can you keep it for him?” asked Lia.
“Sorry, I can't. I drive all day,” said Seu Antônio. “Take it with you. You can leave it at the school office, or you can find Rafa.”
Then the phone vibrated again. Lia read the new message on the screen:

p3x.title: Saturday
text: On Saturday, Lia and Davi arrived at the old cinema at five o'clock. The cinema was closed. It was very old, and the walls were dirty.
They waited behind a tree. At half past five, a young man with a guitar case arrived. After that, a girl came with a big box in her arms.
“Where is the key?” said the girl. “We need to open the door now! Nobody can see us!”
Davi looked at Lia. “They want to go in secretly,” he said. “Maybe they are [[thieves|ladrões]]!”
Lia had the phone and the key in her pocket. Her heart [[beat|bateu]] fast.

p3y.title: Looking for Rafa

text.text: Lia's post got more than two hundred [[likes|curtidas]]. Everybody wanted to know the secret.
Then a girl wrote a comment: “That's my cousin Rafa's phone! Please delete the photo. These messages are [[private|particulares]]!”
Lia felt bad. She deleted the post, but many people already knew about the box.
On Tuesday, Lia asked about Rafa at school. A teacher smiled: “Rafa? He was my student! He studies in Maceió now, but he comes home on Saturdays.”

text: On Friday, a new message appeared on the phone:

text.msg: Rafa arrives at the bus station on Saturday at 4 p.m. Then we go to the cinema. — B

text: Now Lia knew the owner's name. But what was the secret?

p3z.title: The School Office
text: On Tuesday, Lia took the phone to the school office. Dona Célia, the secretary, put it in a box for lost things.
“The owner can come here and get it,” she said.
But nobody came. On Friday, Dona Célia called Lia to the office. The phone was ringing!
Lia answered. A girl was on the phone. “Hello? Who has my cousin's phone? I'm Bia. We need that key tomorrow! It's very important!”

p4a.title: The Police
text: Lia called the police. “There are two thieves at the old cinema!” she said. Ten minutes later, a police car arrived.
The young man and the girl were very surprised. “Thieves? No, no!” said the young man. “I'm Rafa. This is my cousin, Bia. We lost our key!”
Then an old man walked slowly to the cinema. “Rafa? Bia? What's happening?” he asked.
“Oh no,” said Bia. “It's Grandpa! The surprise!”
Lia looked at the key in her hand. Now she understood.

p4b.title: At the Cinema Door

text.text: Lia and Davi watched for a few minutes. The young man and the girl looked sad, not dangerous.
At half past five, Lia arrived at the old cinema. A young man and a girl were at the door. They looked worried.

text: Lia walked to them with the phone. “Is this your phone?” she asked.
“My phone! And the key!” said the young man. “Thank you! I'm Rafa, and this is my cousin, Bia.”

Bia explained: “Our grandpa, Manoel, was the [[projectionist|projecionista]] here many years ago. Today is his birthday. He is eighty years old! We have a surprise for him: his favorite old film, here, in his old cinema!”
“And the box?” asked Lia. “The old film is in the box,” said Rafa. “Grandpa arrives in twenty minutes!”

p4c.title: At the Bus Station
text: On Saturday, Lia waited at the bus station. At four o'clock, a bus from Maceió arrived. A young man with a guitar got off.
“Rafa?” asked Lia. She showed him the phone. “Is this yours?”
“Yes! My phone! And the key!” Rafa smiled. “Thank you! I looked for it everywhere.”

text.text: “My cousin Bia told me about your post,” he said. “Please, don't share more. It's a surprise.”

text: Then he explained: “Today is my grandpa's birthday. He is eighty. Many years ago, he was the [[projectionist|projecionista]] at the old cinema. Tonight, we want to show him his favorite film there!”

p4d.title: A Difficult Friday
text: “I can't go to the school today,” said Bia. “I'm in Maceió. But we need the key tomorrow!”
Lia didn't know what to do. The school closes on the weekend.
Then Dona Célia had an idea. “I live near the old cinema,” she said. “I can take the phone and the key there tomorrow.”
“Or I can take them home,” said Lia, “and go to the cinema myself.”

e1.title: The Best Surprise
text: At six o'clock, Grandpa Manoel arrived at the old cinema. The lights were off. Suddenly, the old projector started, and his favorite film appeared on the screen.
Grandpa cried with happiness. “My cinema! My film!” he said.
Rafa smiled at Lia. “Please, stay with us,” he said. So Lia watched the film with the family. It was the best Saturday of her life.
e1.event: Lia watched the film with the family
e1.eventPt: a Lia assistiu ao filme com a família

e2.title: Almost Too Late
text: Rafa and Bia got the key late. They ran into the cinema, but the old projector didn't start. First, Rafa tried. Then Bia tried. Finally, it worked!
The film started twenty minutes late. Grandpa almost went home! But in the end, he watched his favorite film, and he was very happy.
Lia didn't stay for the film. On the way home, she thought: “I was too slow.”

question.q: Why did the film start late?

e3.title: The Wrong Idea
text: Lia gave the key to Rafa. “I'm so sorry,” she said. “I thought you were thieves!”
The police officers laughed. Grandpa Manoel laughed too. “Thieves? In my old cinema?”
The surprise was not a surprise anymore, but it was a very funny party. Now everybody in Viçosa knows the story of the girl who called the police.

question.q: What did the police officers do?

e4.title: The Newspaper Photo
text: On Saturday, Dona Célia took the phone and the key to the old cinema. Lia stayed at home and watched TV.
On Monday, Lia saw a photo in the newspaper: an old man with a big smile, and the old cinema with its lights on. The title said: “Old cinema opens for one night: a surprise for Mr. Manoel, 80.”
Lia looked at the photo for a long time. “The box… the key… the old cinema!” Now she understood. But she wasn't there.

e5.title: The Lost Key
text: Lia went home with the phone and the key in her bag. She didn't give them to Rafa and Bia.
That night, Rafa and Bia waited at the old cinema, but they couldn't open the door. Grandpa Manoel went home sad.
On Monday, Lia gave the phone and the key to Seu Antônio, the bus driver. “Rafa looked everywhere for this,” he said. Lia felt terrible.

question.q: Why couldn't Rafa and Bia open the door?

e6.title: Too Much Sharing
text: At six o'clock, Grandpa Manoel arrived at the old cinema. He smiled at Rafa and Bia. “I know everything,” he said. “I saw the messages on the internet.”
The film was beautiful, and Grandpa was happy. But it was not a surprise.
Bia looked at Lia. “Private messages are private,” she said. Lia looked down. She learned something important that day.
e6.event: Grandpa discovered the surprise on the internet
